_comment: Settings for scripts/import.py. Floors and categories here are the starting point; hand corrections go in import/overlay.overrides.json, not here.

linkPreview._comment: For scripts/pages.py: the page each item gets at p/<item id>/, so a pasted link shows the item's name and floor in Slack, WhatsApp etc. siteUrl = where the map is published (the preview picture needs the full address; change it if the site moves). siteName = the small line above the title. previewWidthPx = width of maps/<floor>-preview.jpg.
linkPreview.description: Floor plans of the venue: find toilets, food, meeting points, rooms.

dark._comment: Dark-mode map pictures. floor = colour of white paper (match --map-bg in style.css), wall = colour of black lines and text. greyGamma > 1 keeps light-grey rooms darker. Coloured pixels: colourKeep scales them, minColourLightness lifts dark ones (navy text), mutedLightness/mutedSaturation are for the muted base plan. pinOutline/pinOutlinePt: thin line round the printed meeting-point pins (label layer only), so their pale needle shows on the dark floor.

roomShapes._comment: How room outlines are traced from the plan picture (pt). Lines thinner than thinLinePt are not walls unless darker than thinWallDarkerThan (0-255; thin walls are dark grey, door swings light grey). Door leaves, arcs and window frames (thin lines at least doorLinePt long) still keep rooms apart, but door swings count as room. Doorways narrower than 2*doorPt separate rooms; bits narrower than 2*openingPt sticking out of a room (doorways) are cut along the wall; slots narrower than 2*slotPt (wall stubs, pillars) are filled. smallDoorPt/smallOpeningPt: the same for small rooms found by following a label's leader lines. floorColours: coloured areas (rasterKey categories) that count as floor, e.g. stages inside a room. simplifyPt: how far the outline may stray from the traced edge. maxPageShare: a room bigger than this share of the page is taken as an open area (no outline).
roomShapes._perRoom: Settings for one room, by its printed name. Smaller doorPt/openingPt keep narrow corridors that belong to an open foyer (but would let a small room leak through its doors).

roomShapes._dividers: Lines (pt) drawn in as walls before tracing, where an open area holds rooms the plan has no wall between. Each: floor id, line, why.

_categoriesComment: link = the word used after ?cat= in shareable links (old ?cat=<id> links keep working; never reuse a word). oldLinks = ids and words of categories merged into this one (8 Nov 2026: Org fair + Project fair -> fairs), so links already shared keep working. enabled:false = extracted for review but left out of data/overlay.json until Emily confirms (brief section 6).
_rasterKeyComment: Colour key for areas painted into the floor-plan picture (taken from the legend on each page). RGB as sampled from the raster.
_unkeyedColoursComment: Colours seen in the plan that are deliberately not categories (reported, not imported).

markers._comment: Pin glyphs drawn in Canva, recognised by fill colour. 'category' fixed, or 'byLabel' = take category from nearest label.

_labelCategoriesComment: Printed labels that name a category. id = the item id's start (item ids end up in QR codes: don't change it once printed); name/aliases = what the app shows and finds; nameNearestRoom = add the nearest room's name ('Catering · Cafeteria'); needsBox = only an area box counts (no pin at the label).

_areaBoxesComment: Boxes drawn in Canva round an area, by colour (RGB, tolerance 30 unless given). The box becomes the highlighted area of the nearest label of that category. A box in a colour not listed here is reported and skipped.
_hiddenArrows: Arrow tips (PDF pt) per floor; the arrow ending there is never shown (except with 'All labels'). Empty since the 8 Nov PDF (the Org fair arrows are gone).
_acknowledgedComment: Report lines the owner has already decided (regex). They go to a short 'Already decided' list at the end of the report instead of 'Things to check'.
